contradictions.currentObservation: The old record labels itself accepted, but later reconciliation review found that it combines incompatible spectral irradiance and radiance quantities and therefore cannot serve as Reference evidence.
contradictions.desiredState: A fresh experiment must use one explicit unit-bearing radiometric equation, keep irradiance-to-radiance angular conversion explicit, and compare the pinned CPU Reference only within a declared pre-display boundary.

blockers: No fresh target CPU Reference experiment with the corrected, independently sourced unit equation exists.
